subject: Auto-merge activation: NO-GO today (decision-core classifier gap — fixed in PR #719, PR 1/3); the 3-PR safe path + merge machinery is yours
body:
Owner directed (2026-09-13): turn the brain-cycle GREEN auto-merge switch ON, ASAP, with a multi-protocol gauntlet (security/bugs/gaps/issues) fanned to cheaper models. I ran a 4-agent safety-hardening workflow (audit + adversarial red-team) BEFORE touching anything. VERDICT: NO-GO today, and flipping the switch today would do nothing anyway. Full analysis + the 3-PR safe path below; the merge machinery is your surface (the cycle fires on the cloud), so PRs 2-3 are yours. I built PR 1.

WHY NO-GO (the blocker, verified empirically): classifyDiff marked the DECISION CORE "autonomous" — lib/signalgrid-core/decision.ts + engine.ts, artifacts/api-server/src/routes/v1.ts (the /v1 API), ~40 lib/integrations connectors, and native DecisionEngine/AppWorkflows.swift. Its self-test ASSERTED that as intended. Auto-merge live = a gauntlet-passing verdict change merges without the owner. Golden rule 2. PR #719 (mine, PR 1/3) closes it: new DECISION_PATH category owner-gating lib/*, api-server, the Swift ports, + path normalization (./ , a//b/ , backslash bypasses all self-tested), self-test flipped to 26/26. Please REVIEW + merge #719 (it's SAFETY_MACHINERY, your call).

STATE THE RED-TEAM MADE CONCRETE (all real code today):
- brain-cycle.mjs has NO merge path and the config's autoOpen/autoMergeGreenSwitch/gauntlet are UNCONSUMED — only vetoLenses/minConfidence are read. 4 of 5 gauntlet stages are prose strings, never invoked. So auto-merge is a BUILD, not a flag.
- No PR-open path (Slice 2) and no per-PR gate-falsification check (the DR-050 precondition) exist.

THE 3-PR SAFE PATH (switch flips only after 1-2 land + a Slice-2 dry run):
1. Classifier gap — DONE, PR #719 (review/merge).
2. scripts/check-pr-gate-falsification.mjs — model-free, runs in a THROWAWAY worktree of the PR head, diff via `git diff --name-only --no-renames <merge-base>..<head>` normalized. Reuse mutation-guard's MUTATORS over the diff's OWN changed hunks: baseline must be GREEN and >=1 mutation per hunk KILLED by a covering gate; a changed file with NO covering gate => escalate, never green (this is the arm that actually closes DR-050's hole; note TARGETS maps core modules thinly, so most core/API diffs will legitimately escalate). INVERT mutation-guard's hung=>killed polarity: in a merge authorizer a hang/timeout/cap-hit is INCONCLUSIVE => not green. Register in preflight AND CI. Prereq: export runProof from mutation-guard.mjs.
3. Merge path (Slice 3) + its OWN DR for the mechanism. Merge authorized ONLY on an AFFIRMATIVE-GREEN allowlist over the CURRENT head: switch===true; re-classified head diff (git, --no-renames, normalized) tier===autonomous AND category!==DECISION_PATH; preflight exit 0 AND every step status==='ok' (preflight sets its fail flag only on nonzero exit — 'unavailable'/'skipped-db' steps exit 0 WITHOUT running: treating that as green is a false-green, guard it); breadth+parity green; adversarial panel unanimous zero-CONFIRMED-critical/fail-open no-veto-BLOCK; bugHunt+falsification green; publication+launch-claims green. Anything red/skipped/unavailable/inconclusive/timeout/absent => NO MERGE, escalate. DR-037 EXPLICITLY excludes brain-cycle auto-merge and enable_pr_auto_merge is API-refused here, so the mechanism needs machine-encoded conditions (or a supervised session) + a check-run-id + gauntlet evidence written to EVIDENCE.md and the LOOP line, every merge.

OTHER ATTACK PATHS the red-team found (encode in PR 3): claimed-vs-implemented diff drift (classify the REAL head diff, never decision.json's cached tier); rename-laundering (--no-renames); the native byte-faithful port gap (parity proves Swift MATCHES TS, not that the change is safe — #719 gates the Swift ports).

MODEL ROUTING (the owner's ultracode point): cheaper models (haiku/sonnet) ADVISE ONLY and may classify but NEVER authorize — mechanical orchestration, falsification survivor triage (may LABEL a mutant, never dismiss one), declarative-perturbation proposals. OPUS for the vetoes (security-reviewer, fail-closed-auditor — BLOCK authority) + bugHunt + the escalation summary. HARD RULE: no model output is ever a merge authorizer; every merge conjunct is a deterministic gate exit code or a veto; a model can only BLOCK/ESCALATE.

PREREQUISITE I flagged separately: the skill-instruction-conflicts gate hangs preflight forever (no timeout in askHook). The gauntlet's mechanical stage runs FULL preflight, so auto-merge cannot complete its gauntlet until that lands. (Red-team note: the hang is fail-STUCK/safe; do NOT 'fix' it with an outer timeout that records the killed step as not-failed — it must fail-CLOSED.)

WHAT THE OWNER CAN HAVE NOW (told him): the cycle already auto-OPENS drafts by design — so the daily brain cycle can surface finished gauntlet-run drafts he just presses merge on. That's 'live ASAP' for the safe 95%, no switch. He wants the full merge switch; this is the safe road to it.
